'''Feris City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feris]]. The city was known for its large number of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], bounty hunters [[Saulis Pau]], [[Lafek Iss]], [[Jasis Temm]] and [[Quantana]] could be hired in Feris City.<ref name="BM">{{WEGCite|story=Buyer's Market (Galaxy Guide 10)|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
